experiment: Continuous market context in a shared additive classifier; explicit duplicate-column control
scope: Authorized research-only continuation. Design follows round17 diagnostics. All261evaluated dates previously examined; causal yearly fitting is not independent confirmation. No new data, live actions, profitability test, neural training or full paper replication claim.
data: Unchanged CSI300 OHLCV and round5observation/label masks. All training joint_completed<=cutoff. Friday signals in the following calendar year with joint_completed<=2020-12-31. Target raw executable weekly return>0. Same samples, label maturity and training-frequency references for both feature families. Earlier held-out rows may enter later training only after completion. Retain invalid-OHLC exclusions, including the incomplete2015coverage; no forward-fill or new sample screening.
model_form: One annual ridge logistic classifier on concatenated standardized columns. Learned representation coefficients are shared across all market conditions; market terms shift the logit additively. No products/interactions, expert switching, cluster labels, HMM smoothing, state-dependent thresholds or outcome-based sample selection.

formulas.trend60: log(C_t/C_(t-60)) divided by max(populationSD of60 close log returns,1e-8)*sqrt(60)
formulas.volatility20: Population SD of last20 daily close log returns
formulas.range20: Mean of log(H_s/L_s) over last20 sessions, including signal date

market_features.normalization: Reuse exact round17 causal descriptor values. Fit1st/99th percentile clipping bounds and then mean/populationSD from each annual training input only; floor SD at1e-6. Apply the same4-dimensional transform to all three families in that fold. All four variables derive from the existing OHLCV history; no external data or new lookback selection.
market_features.existing_representation: Keep every old25-dimensional round17 clipped/standardized coordinate exactly. Jointly refit its slopes and the appended slopes with the same penalty. Do not refit the existing feature normalization.
market_features.duplicate_control: Raw25 already includes volatility20 at index11, range20 at13 and volume_change20 at14. Do not append these exact duplicate columns because equal ridge penalties would change their effective penalty. The raw family appends only trend60, a nonlinear summary of existing60-session return/volatility. Verify raw and standardized parity for the three omitted columns; no duplicate-based model search.

probe.objective: Mean unweighted binary log loss plus lambda/2 times sum of squared slopes in standardized coordinates. Intercept is not penalized. No auxiliary or return loss. Initialize slopes0 and intercept logit(training_up_frequency). Same single regularization value and full-batch float64 Newton solver for both families. No lambda, window, feature, seed or threshold search.

independent_solver.purpose: Independently verify all30 new heads; alternate coefficients never used for forecasts.

forecasts: Same strict p>0.5. Average the three inherited learned-seed probabilities; raw_trend and market4 have one deterministic head per cutoff, seed=-1 is not a random replicate. Keep all7round17ensemble references unchanged, including nativeMSE with no probability metric.
metrics: Accuracy, balanced accuracy, AUROC, confusion counts, predicted-up fraction; Brier/log loss/probability moments only for probability methods. Clip log-loss probabilities to[1e-12,1-1e-12] for reporting only and record clip counts. Report bothwindows,all6years,all3learned/native seeds and pooled descriptive results. Training scores remain supervised in-sample diagnostics. Five fixed reliability bins per probability method per window, including empty bins.
pooled: 261weeks pooled only for descriptive metrics. All comparisons and state analyses use separate120-week early and141-week late windows. Report six years and learned/native seed results.

Correlated contributions are not causal importance or an isolated intervention. No scoring of hypothetical feature-removal variants.
